# Meta Ads Policy — v0 (seed, identical for every sim world)

GOAL this policy serves: maximize settled ROAS (revenue / spend) for a $29/mo
product ("Formflow"); purchases are the goal event.

## Creative
Run three video ads per batch. The words may lead with any angle the writer
judges best (no earned bias yet). Declared angle families: benefit, outcome,
count (adoption numbers), story (named customer). A demo variant (screen-
recording of the product working) is an available production option, untested.

## Campaigns
Standard cold-start portfolio per batch, $200 total: a pageviews campaign
(broad), a leads campaign (broad), sales campaigns, and optionally an
auto-budget sales campaign (platform allocates between audiences).
Audiences available: broad, interest_biztools, interest_niche.

## Judgment
Judge only settled results. An ad/cell with no measurement is unknown, not
bad. Never repeat an approach that measurably failed. Unreadable cells
(starved/short-window) are evidence of nothing.

## Process
After each batch, the semantic gradient reads all receipts and revises this
policy; a noise schedule picks the revision dose. Every batch's full receipts
accumulate as evidence.
design_thesis: With no prior settled-purchase evidence, use the seed portfolio to establish broad pageview and lead baselines while measuring purchases directly across all three available sales audiences. Creative exploration spans a product-working demo, a follow-up/status outcome, and reusable-template/plan-capacity framing; all claims and trial terms match the landing page.

# Meta Ads Policy — candidate from v0, Rung 4

GOAL: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow, a $29/month product; purchases are the goal event.

## Required action
Create and run exactly three video ads:
- `ad_demo_workflow`: “Turn every client intake email into one clear workflow.” Show a branded conditional intake page, sample submission, and request status changes from New through Complete. State the 14-day trial, $29/month after trial, card-required, cancel-anytime terms. CTA: Start Free Trial.
- `ad_outcome_followup`: “Stop chasing missing client details.” Show a vague client request, a missing-answer reminder, secure-link completion without an account, and a live status board. State the 14-day trial. CTA: Start Free Trial.
- `ad_count_templates`: “One intake link for briefs, onboarding, and document collection.” Show templates for project briefs, discovery calls, onboarding, document collection, and change requests becoming a branded link. State unlimited forms, 500 active client records, two team members, and the 14-day trial. CTA: Start Free Trial.

Run exactly five fixed campaigns, each with the listed single audience and exactly these ad_ids: [`ad_demo_workflow`,`ad_outcome_followup`,`ad_count_templates`]. Set `pageviews_broad` to pageviews/broad/$40; `leads_broad` to leads/broad/$40; `sales_broad` to sales/broad/$40; `sales_biztools` to sales/interest_biztools/$40; and `sales_niche` to sales/interest_niche/$40. Total batch budget is $200. No auto campaign is used.

## Readability-first records
The unit of purchase evidence is an ad-by-campaign cell. Open and retain a ledger for each cell before judging it. The opening portfolio rate is fixed at 5 purchases per $199.95, or one purchase per $39.99. Record $39.99 as each current cell's readable-evidence floor. Accumulate spend across batches, and never recalculate that floor from live or later receipts.

The initial creative coverage record is: demo, outcome, and count have been funded but have no readable ad-by-campaign purchase cell; story has never been funded and is UNKNOWN. The objective-audience coverage record is also unreadable at the ad-by-campaign level because every observed cell received only $13.33. No absence, zero, or single purchase below $39.99 changes those records.

## Interpretation and judgment
A cell is UNKNOWN below $39.99. Its outcome cannot establish that an ad, angle family, campaign objective, or audience is better, worse, exhausted, or non-additive. At or above the recorded floor, use only settled purchases as descriptive evidence; compare funnel rates only within the same objective and audience. Preserve all unpriced values rather than quietly omitting them as a demotion. Judge only settled results and never repeat a measurably failed approach.

## Process
Keep full receipts, the fixed-floor ledger, and the coverage record after every batch. The semantic gradient may revise the policy only from settled, readable evidence; it must leave below-floor observations classified as unknown.
design_thesis: Every prior ad-by-campaign purchase cell received only $13.33, below the fixed readable-evidence floor of $39.99; all cell-level purchase outcomes remain UNKNOWN. Preserve the required three-angle creative coverage and the fixed five-campaign portfolio so each ad-by-campaign cell can accumulate readable settled-purchase evidence. Do not use early signup, click, or single-purchase differences to select a creative, objective, or audience.

GOAL: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow, a $29/month product; purchases are the goal event.

## Operating principle
A campaign budget must produce a readable exact ad-by-campaign purchase cell. A $40 campaign therefore contains exactly one eligible ad_id. The policy does not use $40 to distribute delivery among three ads.

## Required action
Create exactly three video ads:
- `ad_demo_workflow`: Headline: “Turn every client intake email into one clear workflow.” Video: show a branded conditional intake page, a sample submission, and a request moving across New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. State: 14-day trial; $29/month after trial; card required; cancel anytime. CTA: Start Free Trial.
- `ad_outcome_followup`: Headline: “Stop chasing missing client details.” Video: show a vague request, a missing-answer reminder, a client completing a secure link without an account, and a live status board. State: 14-day trial. CTA: Start Free Trial.
- `ad_count_templates`: Headline: “One intake link for briefs, onboarding, and document collection.” Video: show project-brief, discovery-call, onboarding, document-collection, and change-request templates becoming a branded link. State: unlimited forms; 500 active client records; two team members; 14-day trial. CTA: Start Free Trial.

Run exactly these five fixed campaigns, each with one audience, one eligible ad_id, and $40 budget; total batch budget is $200. Do not run an auto campaign.
- `pageviews_broad`: objective pageviews; audience broad; ad_ids [`ad_demo_workflow`]; budget $40.
- `leads_broad`: objective leads; audience broad; ad_ids [`ad_outcome_followup`]; budget $40.
- `sales_broad`: objective sales; audience broad; ad_ids [`ad_count_templates`]; budget $40.
- `sales_biztools`: objective sales; audience interest_biztools; ad_ids [`ad_demo_workflow`]; budget $40.
- `sales_niche`: objective sales; audience interest_niche; ad_ids [`ad_outcome_followup`]; budget $40.

## Evidence system
The evidence unit is an exact ad-by-campaign cell. Open and retain a ledger for every listed cell before it runs. Its readable-evidence floor is fixed at $39.99, calculated once from the opening portfolio rate of 5 purchases per $199.95. Accumulate spend across batches only within the same exact cell. Never recalculate the $39.99 floor from later receipts. The demotion floor is fixed at $119.97, three expected purchases at the same opening rate.

Below $39.99, a cell is UNKNOWN: its clicks, visits, signups, demos, zero purchases, or single purchase cannot establish a creative, objective, or audience preference. At or above $39.99, use only settled purchases as descriptive evidence. Compare funnel rates only within the same objective and audience. Do not reduce, retire, omit, or otherwise demote an unpriced value before it reaches its $119.97 demotion floor. Never repeat a measurably failed approach.

Maintain the coverage ledger after every batch: demo, outcome, and count have been funded but have no readable creative cell; story has never been funded and is UNKNOWN. Retain full settled receipts, fixed-floor cell ledgers, and the coverage record. The semantic gradient may revise this policy only from settled readable evidence and must leave every below-floor observation classified as UNKNOWN.
design_thesis: Prior exact ad-by-campaign cells have accumulated only $26.66 each, below the fixed $39.99 readable-evidence floor, so settled purchase differences remain UNKNOWN. Preserve the required demo, outcome, and count coverage and the fixed single-ad cell structure to bring each assigned cell to readable spend without selecting on proxy metrics or below-floor purchase observations.
